lead.headline: No change overnight: McLaurin and Coker are both game-day calls for one flex slot
lead.deck: Jefferson is out and Addison is in his slot. The flex is a questionable McLaurin over a questionable Coker, with Kamara as the last resort. The check that matters is Washington's inactives at 06:00 tomorrow.
lead.body: Nothing about your two hurt receivers resolved overnight. Terry McLaurin, the flex, practised in full on Wednesday and Thursday, then a hamstring came up in Friday's session in London; he is questionable, 'a true game-time decision', and Dan Quinn has said nothing. His 13.1 has not moved, so the injury is not in the number. The cover, Jalen Coker at 13.0, is no clearer: Dave Canales said on Friday that Carolina would move him around again on Saturday and see how the quad is on game day. So nothing moves today. Tomorrow, check Washington's inactives at 06:00: if McLaurin is out, Coker takes the flex, and because Coker plays last, Alvin Kamara can still replace him at 16:50. Justin Jefferson is out and Jordan Addison starts for him at 14.8, on the projection. Around them the week is quiet: Josh Allen has no designation, Isaiah Likely's Giants list nobody, and Chicago are expected to start Tyson Bagent, which touches only the benched Kyle Monangai. On the wire, George Holani and Makai Lemon are rising on other teams' injuries and neither reaches this lineup. The waiver tool's one question, Denzel Boston, is real as a role and locked until Wednesday; he joins DK Metcalf as Tuesday's decision.
